thread:
jamal: Heads up — we're scheduling a staging pen-test dry run (convoy wavecheck) for next Tues 09:00 PT. Need to lock down access cadence, KMS proxy behavior, and what log samples we hand to the assessor.
emily: SGTM. Do we have a proposed evidence manifest?
jamal: rough list: presigned s3 artifacts (app logs + audit logs), ephemeral IAM creds for read-only, KMS-wrapped archive keys, and a minimal playbook of repro steps. Also we need clarity on what log sampling window is acceptable (1h vs 24h). @tanya can you be ops lead?
tanya: I can run ops lead for the dry run. Prefer 1h rolling window + targeted 24h for high-risk endpoints. We should avoid sending full DB dumps.
mike: For the KMS proxy: current plan is to create an ephemeral DELEGATE role that can decrypt a single object key and only for the TTL of the presign (1hr). That keeps plaintext off the wire. Thoughts?
jamal: That sounds right. Two questions: 1) Can we prove auditor-only decrypt of object K without broad kms:Decrypt? 2) Who will perform the artifact upload + manifest signing?
kms-bot: KMS policy note: you can create a Grant with constraints limiting to specific ciphertext/ENCRYPTED_DATA_KEY. Example grant command:
```
aws kms create-grant \\
  --key-id alias/prod-logs \\
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-auditor \\
  --operations Decrypt \\
  --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"purpose":"pt-evidence"}
```
emily: Nice. For presigned artifacts we should put a short manifest.json next to each bundle with fields: checksum, object_key, kms_key_id, ttl, uploader. Example manifest snippet: `{\"object\":\"app-logs-2026-03-20.tar.gz\", \"sha256\":\"<hash>\", \"kms\":\"arn:aws:kms:...\", \"ttl\":\"3600\"}`
jamal: @mike can you run the upload + sign step in staging and post the manifest link here? Also request that the assessor uses only the grant — no full account role.
mike: I'll do a dry upload tonight to the staging bucket and attach the manifest. Plan: script `scripts/pt_upload.sh` will create presign and call KMS grant helper. Quick preview:
```
# pt_upload.sh (preview)
ART=app-logs-2026-03-20.tar.gz
aws s3 cp $ART s3://redwood-pt-staging/$ART
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/staging-logs ... > /tmp/grant.json
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-staging/$ART --expires-in 3600
```
jamal: Perfect. For log sampling, we agreed 1h for general, 24h for high-risk. We'll include a small extraction script that pulls just ERROR/ERROR_RATE spikes and auth-fail sequences.
tanya: Ops will also capture host-level audit logs for the 1h window (syscalls + kube-audit). We'll sanitize PII. Add checklist item: confirm sanitized sample by security before handing over.
emily: Add to checklist: evidence sha256, manifest signed (GPG or KMS key-signature), grant ARN, presign TTL, and assessor contact.
jamal: Can we get retest cadence pinned? I'd like a 2-week retest window after fixes are applied. If the assessor needs more time, we'll schedule a second convoy wave.
tanya: 2-week retest is fine. Add fallback: if fix increases risk surface, escalate to incident channel and freeze deploys for that service.
mike: Upload done — manifest link: https://staging.s3.console.aws.amazon.com/.../app-logs-2026-03-20-manifest.json (presigned). Grant ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:grant/0a1b2c3d4e5f.
jamal: Posted — thanks @mike. I'll notify the assessor and confirm the exact start time. Action items:
- tanya: ops lead for dry run + sanitization check
- mike: run upload + provide presign (done)
- emily: verify manifest format + sign requirement
- jamal: coordinate assessor contact + retest cadence
Please react with :thumbsup: when you ack.
emily: :thumbsup: acked.
tanya: :thumbsup: I'll run the sanitization check at 08:30 PT on test day.
mike: :thumbsup: logs uploaded, will monitor access.
kms-bot: Reminder scheduled: revoke grant arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:grant/0a1b2c3d4e5f at 2026-03-20T10:15:00Z (automated).
jamal: closing the loop — we'll do a short post-mortem in #eng-security after the dry run. Thanks team.
